label: input token l at the start of the sequence (position 0 or 1)
explanation: Fires only when the input token is l during the first two original-phase steps. At t=0, l always fires at the max activation (1.317), which is 86% of the mass; the t=0 clause alone has precision 1.0. At t=1, l fires more weakly (usually 0.03-0.5 of max), and how strongly depends on the preceding token: after a, c, o, x it often does not fire at all, which accounts for most of the false positives. Tiny residual activations (<0.02 of max) occur on l at t=2 after prefixes like m z / 1 1. Never fires on any other token, on l at t>=2 in any real amount, or in the delimiter or copy phases.

issues: The false positives are not scattered noise. They form one clean class. On the dev split, at t=1 with in_tok=l, the feature has precision exactly 0.0 when prev_tok is in {a,c,d,i,o,r,x} and exactly 1.0 for each of the other 23 previous tokens. The explanation says 'after tokens like a, c, o and x it often does not fire'. That understates it: the feature never fires after these 7 tokens and always fires after the rest. It also leaves out d, i and r.

When the t=1 clause excludes those 7 previous tokens, the 3893 test false positives (precision 0.883) all go away. Test precision rises to 1.000 with recall unchanged at 0.998, so F1 goes from 0.937 to 0.999.

Every other claim checks out. Delimiter and copy phases have 0 activations. No token other than l ever fires. t=0 carries 86.4% of the activation mass and fires at max. The t=0 clause alone has test precision 1.0 (recall 0.563). The t=2 activations are tiny (59 test steps, about 0% of mass) and follow 'm z', 'm 1' or '1 1' prefixes.
The label 'input token l at position 0 or 1' slightly overclaims at position 1, because the feature is silent at t=1 whenever the previous token is one of the 7 above.
skeptic.revised_label: input token l at position 0 (always, at max), or at position 1 unless the previous token is a, c, d, i, o, r or x

final_label: input token l at position 0 (always, at max), or at position 1 unless the previous token is a, c, d, i, o, r or x
